blocks.text: New Horizons: streets and boundaries

items.t: The sub-area name is a real-estate board name, not a City neighbourhood name: the City plans this area as part of its city centre, while the developer, Polygon, calls the master-planned community here Windsor Gate.
Glen Drive is the east–west street through the pocket: École Glen Elementary School is at 3064 Glen Drive, and the Windsor Gate towers stand on Windsor Gate just off Glen Drive.

blocks.text: New Horizons: the housing stock

items.t: Windsor Gate is the defining stock here: Polygon states it is a 25-acre master-planned community begun in 2008, built in a Frank Lloyd Wright-inspired style with wide, landscaped boulevards, and mixing high-rise towers with low-rise apartment buildings around a residents-only club.

The Lloyd, Windsor Gate, Polygon, concrete high-rise tower: Polygon describes solid concrete construction, cantilevered lines, brick detailing and decorative metal screens, with interiors built around overheight ceilings.

blocks.text: New Horizons: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Windsor Gate ownership carries the Nakoma Club with it: Polygon states homeowners in Windsor Gate get membership to the residents-only, 18,000-square-foot Nakoma Club, so a buyer here is buying into a shared amenity facility as well as a strata unit, and the club's costs sit inside the strata's finances.

The whole city is now covered by the Interim OCP, Bylaw No. 5511, 2026, adopted April 27, 2026, which replaced the former citywide plan and carries the former area plans in as schedules, because older plan references for the city centre area are superseded.

blocks.text: New Horizons: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Glen Park is the pocket's public park, and it is still changing: the City states it is working towards the next phase of improvements for Glen Park, with the project page last updated October 20, 2026.
Coquitlam River Park is one block from Windsor Gate, by the developer's own description, which puts a river park at the east edge of a high-density pocket.

Douglas College's Coquitlam campus and the Evergreen Cultural Centre are part of the pocket's daily geography: Polygon lists both among the amenities of this area, along with Lafarge Lake and Coquitlam Centre.

Pipeline Road construction is not finished at the pocket's edge: the City is also running Pipeline Road active transportation and road safety improvements from Guildford Way to Lincoln Avenue, a segment that passes the Windsor Gate area.

blocks.text: New Horizons: development and new projects

items.t: Pipeline Road Upgrade Project, Pipeline Road from Guildford Way to David Avenue, City of Coquitlam capital project, road and active-transportation work: expansion to four lanes, a pedestrian pathway, two-way micromobility lane, intersection upgrades, lighting and boulevard trees — status: under construction in phases through 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

Coquitlam Water Main, Robson to Guildford section, Pipeline Road between Robson Drive and Guildford Way, Metro Vancouver, drinking-water main: this section is 1.4 kilometres long and 3.2 metres in diameter; construction started in fall 2023 with estimated completion in fall 2026, and later sections run to 2034 — status: under construction (as of November 3, 2026).

Glen Park Improvements, Glen Park, beside Windsor Gate, City of Coquitlam park project: the City is working towards the next phase of improvements — status: planning, project page last updated October 20, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: New Horizons: costs and taxes

items.t: Coquitlam is a designated taxable area for the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax, so a residential owner in New Horizons must complete the annual declaration, including an owner holding a Windsor Gate strata unit.

blocks.text: New Horizons: getting around

items.t: Route 186 runs past the pocket on Pinetree Way: from Coquitlam Central Station via Pinetree Way — serving Lincoln Station and Lafarge Lake-Douglas Station and the Pinetree Way stop at Glen Drive — then David Avenue and Pipeline Road toward Hampton Park.
Route 188 uses the same Pinetree Way stations and then runs David Avenue and Coast Meridian Road to Port Coquitlam Station, giving the pocket a one-bus link east into Port Coquitlam.
The two SkyTrain stations on the pocket's west edge, Lincoln Station and Lafarge Lake-Douglas Station, are both on the Millennium Line Evergreen Extension.

blocks.text: New Horizons: risks and due diligence

items.t: River-edge lots need a flood check, not an assumption: the City's floodplain mapping work covers the Coquitlam River floodplain, and the detached streets at the east side of this sub-area sit near that river corridor, so a specific lot's flood status is read from City mapping, not from the tower addresses on Windsor Gate.

Strata buyers here carry a second building to diligence: the Nakoma Club is a shared, residents-only facility, so its operating costs, reserves and any special levies flow through Windsor Gate strata budgets and should be read in the strata documents alongside the individual building's.

Construction exposure is current and dated: Pipeline Road carries both a City road widening and a Metro Vancouver water main through 2026, so access, noise and detours on the pocket's east side should be checked against the project pages before completion dates are assumed.

blocks.text: New Horizons home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

59 condos sold in New Horizons with a median price of $695,000 (the middle half sold between $640,000 and $776,400), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $761 per square foot, a median year built of 2016 and a median strata fee of $441 a month. 23 houses sold in New Horizons with a median price of $1,200,000 (the middle half sold between $1,111,500 and $1,256,444), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $601 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 4,101 square feet.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in New Horizons?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 5 houses and 24 condos and townhomes listed in New Horizons. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is New Horizons a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 40% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type; condos and townhomes had 33% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in New Horizons from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses and 35 condos and townhomes sold in New Horizons over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in July with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 11 sold.

faq.q: How big is New Horizons compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, New Horizons held 1.3% of the 378 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 3.1% of the 779 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in New Horizons?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 17.2% of the 29 homes listed in New Horizons and condos and townhomes made up 82.8%; of the 10 that sold, houses were 20.0% and condos and townhomes 80.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in New Horizons than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses was little changed, 5 in June and 5 in October 2026 (+0.0%); condos and townhomes fell from 33 in June to 24 in October 2026 (−27.3%).

faq.q: What exactly is the Nakoma Club, and who can use it?
faq.a: The Nakoma Club is Windsor Gate's private, residents-only clubhouse. Polygon describes 18,000 square feet with an outdoor pool, a landscaped terrace, a fully equipped fitness centre, a gymnasium, a screening room, guest suites and a concierge. It is an amenity for Windsor Gate homeowners, not a public recreation centre, so a buyer outside Windsor Gate cannot use it, and a buyer inside it should read how it is funded in the strata documents.

faq.q: Which schools serve the Windsor Gate pocket?
faq.a: Polygon names the schools in this area as Westwood Elementary, École Glen Elementary School, École Maple Creek Middle School and Pinetree Secondary. Glen Elementary is at 3064 Glen Drive, in the pocket, and Pinetree Secondary is at 3000 Pinewood Avenue. School District No. 43 (Coquitlam) assigns students by permanent home address, so a tower address and a detached address on the same street can fall in different catchments and must be checked separately.

faq.q: How close is rapid transit, in the operator's own terms?
faq.a: Two Millennium Line stations sit on Pinetree Way at the west side of the pocket: Lincoln Station and Lafarge Lake-Douglas Station. TransLink's route 186 timetable names both stations on its run along Pinetree Way past Glen Drive, and route 188 uses the same two stations. There is no station inside Windsor Gate itself; the stations are the pocket's western edge, reached via Glen Drive and Pinetree Way.

faq.q: What major road and water work is happening on Pipeline Road?
faq.a: Two projects overlap on the pocket's east side. The City is upgrading Pipeline Road from Guildford Way to David Avenue to four lanes with a pedestrian pathway and a two-way micromobility lane, and Metro Vancouver is building the Coquitlam Water Main, whose Robson to Guildford section runs along Pipeline Road between Robson Drive and Guildford Way, with construction started in fall 2023 and estimated completion in fall 2026.

faq.q: What did condos in New Horizons sell for?
faq.a: 59 condos sold in New Horizons between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $695,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in New Horizons?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
